page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head and page number at the top. Gathering signature and catchword at the foot. Left margin carries only show-through marks and no printed notes. Faint fragments at the lower right edge are show-through and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: omnes clauderentur. Quæ fanè conjunctio major atque arctior erat, quàm quæ colendæ amicitiæ causa, addo etiam mutuorum auxiliorum gratia per fœdera communiter confcifcuntur. Et quamvis civitates fingulæ aliæ aliis majores & ditiores majorumque virium essent, tamen nullæ aliis quicquam præscribebant, aut imperii aliquid in eas usurpabant, jufve fuperius, ut vulgò loquuntur, prætendebant: omnes verò pari inter fe jure agebant, nec heic antiquius tempus, quo in societatem venerant, quicquam valebat: minima & ultima tantundem in decernendo ferendove suffragio, aut in ordine confessus, quantum maxima & tempore prima poterat, nisi quòd autoritatis plus aliæ quàm aliæ ad deliberationes adserrent. Quinetiam hoc in institutis hujus societatis erat, si quæ civitas, si quis populus in Peloponneso non solum sponte suâ, aut verborum suadelâ, sed etiam metu & armorum vi cogente societati accederet, ut ea civitas atque is populus ejusdem juris compos statim & particeps fieret, quod erat fœderis aut societatis universæ. Fiebatque utpluri-mum, quæ primum adversa mente, adeoque armis compulsæ in societatem trahebantur, ut eas paulò pòst propter
main_text.notes: Show-through fragments at the lower right ("-bra", "q- -pt") and dark bleed marks along the left edge are not printed text and are omitted. The small stroke after "eas" in line 14 is a stain, not a printed mark. The text is transcribed with long s rendered as plain s. The printed hyphen in "utpluri-mum" marks a line-end break.
